root_cause: The scoped SUPABASE_ACCESS_TOKEN was valid and the official Supabase Management/API source readback was byte-identical to protected main, but `supabase functions download` without `--use-api` extracted the provider ESZIP locally and produced a transformed index.ts. The authority therefore reported SUPABASE_EDGE_PROVIDER_SOURCE_DRIFT even though provider version 122 and GitHub main had identical source.
prevention_rule: Terminal provider source parity must use `supabase functions download --use-api` with the read-only PAT so unbundling occurs server-side. The default local Docker/ESZIP extraction path is forbidden for terminal byte parity because extraction can transform source or filesets.

evidence.management_api_truth: powerhouse-social-publisher provider v122 equals protected-main source exactly at 111543 bytes
evidence.upstream_cli_capability: supabase functions download supports --use-api for server-side unbundling
